name: Spaces
description: Document Spaces: the shared store every note, doc, and RAG-indexed file lands in. The dependency target other apps declare when they own Space documents.

permission_levels.label: Can read
permission_levels.description: Open a space and read its documents, including files other apps filed there.

permission_levels.label: Can write
permission_levels.description: Add and change documents in a space, which also changes what retrieval feeds back into chat.

permission_levels.label: Can delete
permission_levels.description: Permanently remove documents and whole spaces, including anything other apps stored in them.
